text: Absolutely, the library should extend its evening hours! With a certified night staffing plan in place to cover security needs, this initiative represents an innovative solution that allows us to offer something truly unique—an "evening hour" event called the Midnight Reading Festival. This novel concept could attract a broader audience and foster a sense of community among those who value quiet study times. Additionally, the lighting retrofit has dramatically reduced operational costs, making it economically viable to operate even later without compromising sustainability or accessibility. Moreover, the success of a nearby branch suggests that extending operating hours can be both practical and popular, enhancing overall patron satisfaction. It’s time to lead rather than follow when it comes to providing resources and opportunities for our users to thrive.
